customrecordcustomfield.description: THE EXECUTION-ENVIRONMENT GATE (SAFE Q1.20). What this configuration row is for. jj_rb_io.client.call compares it with runtime.envType on every call and suppresses the call on a mismatch. A sandbox refreshed from production copies this row still saying PRODUCTION, which is exactly what the gate detects. The free-text Name field is not a substitute - the gate needs a comparable value.
